name: Release v2026.12.0
body:
## 🤖 AI-Generated Changelog

## Fixed

- Dropped `cache-dir` value from constraint files to prevent invalid constraint file generation
- Kept extras on file and path dependencies in requirements output
- Kept `sys_platform` markers on path/file entries when using `--from-pipfile`
- Preserved literal percent escapes in local file URL conversion; fixed double-decoding of file URLs
- Stopped Rich from wrapping `--json`, `--json-tree`, and `--bare` graph output
- Escaped Rich markup in subprocess output displayed during locking and graph errors
- Kept going and exited non-zero when `pip uninstall` fails during `clean`/`uninstall` operations, rather than stopping silently
- Showed pip's stderr output when `pip uninstall` fails
- Used resolved package names for editable installs during uninstall
- Kept the downloaded requirements file when running `pipenv install -r <url>`
- Ran the direct `pip install` safety retry using `subprocess.run` in `check`/`scan`
- Fell back to default values when numeric environment variables contain non-integer values
- Raised clean errors for malformed `[scripts]` entries instead of cryptic tracebacks
- Fixed VCS URL handling: no longer appends empty revision for ref-less entries; extras are no longer incorrectly included on VCS URLs; name-discovery parsers now return `None` on malformed input
- Tolerated `Name:<val>` (no space) metadata format in dependency parsing
- Fixed missing f-string in vendored subdependency license path
- Fixed vendoring license download compatibility with Python 3.15 runners

---

🔗 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pypa/pipenv/compare/v2026.11.0...v2026.12.0
